name: Shelf Picked

angles.text: Running couriered errands between Stormwind's libraries and local gathering spots reflects the quiet everyday civic life carrying on in the capital amidst wider kingdom tensions.

faq.answer: The quest is received from a librarian overseeing inventory at a library after Roy Lewells sends an errand note. The librarian verifies that Roy's requested reading list is in stock, but directs you to pull the volumes from the shelves yourself.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Shelf Picked?

faq.answer: Roy Lewells is an organizer of a local reading group based around Stormwind's Park. He sends couriers to retrieve reserved books from the library for upcoming after-hours discussions held in their cellar.

The quest takes place at a library where Mr. Lewells's reading selections are kept in stock. The overseeing librarian manages the inventory records while couriers search the premises' shelves for the specific texts requested.
faq.q: Where does the book collection take place?

faq.answer: Roy Lewells requested the reading materials for an informal book club to spark lively discussions among members. Because of the nature of their gatherings, they convene after hours in a cellar once the books are delivered.
faq.q: Why does Roy Lewells need these books?

aliases: am i responsible for returning books
faq.answer: No. The librarian explicitly clarifies that acting as an official courier with Roy Lewells's note exempts you from personal accountability for returning the volumes; the burden of returning the books rests solely with Roy's establishment.
faq.q: Are you responsible for returning the borrowed books?

aliases: where do you turn in shelf picked
faq.answer: You deliver the collected reading materials directly back to Roy Lewells, who can be found in the Park district of the city of Stormwind.
faq.q: Where do you bring the books once retrieved?

sections.body: Shelf Picked involves acting as an official courier for Roy Lewells, a resident connected to Stormwind's Park district. Roy submits a request for various reading selections, and while the presiding librarian confirms every listed title is in stock, the courier must personally locate and pull each volume from the shelves. The librarian remains at the desk attending to supervisory bookkeeping, ensuring proper inventory records are maintained while delegating the physical retrieval.
sections.title: An Errand for the Stacks

sections.body: Handling borrowed library volumes often carries strict return obligations, but carrying Roy Lewells's authorization provides official courier status. The supervising librarian notes that personal accountability does not fall on the runner; instead, Lewells's establishment bears full responsibility for returning the borrowed works. Once delivered to the Park, Roy prepares the exotic-smelling volumes for lively, after-hours discussions hosted down in a cellar.
sections.title: The Cellar Reading Club

summary: Shelf Picked is a courier errand in Stormwind requiring the retrieval of a specific reading list from library shelves for Roy Lewells. Serving as an authorized intermediary, the runner pulls the volumes on behalf of a local book club gathering in the Park.
